checks.command: Strict document rules on the plan, policy, linked contract and canonical task definitions

checks.initial_warning: The previous latest audit was stale; the bounded current-plan audit records fresh scoped evidence.

checks.command: Installer list and temporary all-provider general dry-run

coverage_gaps: No Auto/Manual implementation, external candidate activation, comparison, native host/provider runtime, browser, Unity, device or live service was executed.
The current manual-only controller remains the accepted runtime baseline. W1/W2 implementation and bounded comparative agreement remain future delivery gates.
Exposed suite results establish the recorded deterministic checks, not universal agent adherence or plugin efficacy.

findings.observation: An editor-only Processing configuration had no complete semantic-decision and acceptance path.
findings.resolution: The plan defines all four plugin combinations; editor-only uses shared core clarification and mode-specific acceptance without external interview execution.

findings.observation: Mode switching preserved history without reconciling live attempts, late replies or current-mode acceptance.
findings.resolution: The switch reconciles or cancels original attempts, treats late replies as historical/stale and requires current-mode/current-authority acceptance.

findings.observation: Default Auto lacked an explicit outcome for an unavailable required independent actor.
findings.resolution: Unavailable/prerequisite evidence preserves the decision/hold and requires a supported retry or explicit Manual switch; false independence is tested.

findings.observation: Pre-promotion Processing hooks lacked a Pending identity boundary despite T-only clarification admission.
findings.resolution: Before/during hooks retain exact P-identities and unresolved Pending; T-task clarification starts only after promotion.

findings.observation: The implementation during anchor was not ordered against final plan review and acceptance.
findings.resolution: During follows plan drafting and precedes current-plan acceptance; plan changes invalidate review before source edits.

findings.observation: The linked planned plugin contract retained core-only and owner-only requirements inconsistent with approved W1/W2.
findings.resolution: The planned contract has explicit W1/W2 precedence, mode-specific answers/acceptance and task-editorial paths; current manual controller documentation remains truthful.

findings.observation: Lifecycle activation/removal and final refresh omitted the existing canonical stopped-operation barrier.
findings.resolution: The plan and contract preserve the canonical writer/installation barrier, retained-run inspection, stopped handoff and changed-generation re-admission.

findings.observation: The required foundation Pending still described W2 as open after actual owner approval.
findings.resolution: An owned guarded queue transaction updates the exact Pending context to actual W1/W2 approval and the editorial/shared dependency handoff.

findings.observation: Usage accounting described API calls/tokens/cost as unknown even when actual measurements could be exposed.
findings.resolution: The plan retains actual exposed measurements and marks only unexposed accounting and identity unknown.
